subject: Novafin hosted usage + rate policy: proposed monthly commit and burst plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novafin Billing <billing@novafin.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the heads up on the renewal. Quick update from our side: the product team is forecasting a 2.5x spike in inference traffic starting June as we onboard a new partner. We want to avoid throttling and maintain the SLA we’ve had this year.

Can you send options for (a) a straightforward commit increase and (b) a short-term burst allowance we can buy for the peak while we finalize usage patterns? Also, what are the implications for per-token rate bands if we move to the 3x commit?

Best,
Elena
VP Product, Novafin

--
Novafin (external)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the forecast.

Short answer: yes, we can do both. I pulled together two paths for you:
- Option A: 3x monthly commit (12-month term), lowers per-token unit price into the next rate band, keeps current latency SLOs.
- Option B: base commit + 60-day burst package (one-time prepaid pool) to cover the initial spike; after 60 days we can convert to a larger commit if traffic stabilizes.

I attached a proposal (2027-05-02_novafin_proposal_v2.xlsx) and a concise rate table (rate_table_v3.pdf). The proposal includes an expected effective per-token price and example monthly invoice for both options.

Quick clarifying Qs before kitting the legal/finance language:
1) Is Novafin comfortable with a 12-month minimum on Option A?
2) For Option B, do you want burst to be automatically applied or require a finance approval each time it’s used?

Ben, Karthik — looping you in to confirm pricing limits and to propose a short addendum we can sign fast.

Thanks,
Mina
Account Executive 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-05-02_novafin_proposal_v2.xlsx (pricing worksheet), rate_table_v3.pdf (rate bands and burst rules)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Elena / Mina — loud and clear. Some notes on pricing and ops:

- If Novafin moves to a 3x commit (Option A) we can drop the hosted per-token rate by ~18% compared to your current band; exact numbers in the attached.
- Burst pool (Option B) should be prepaid and expires in 60 days by default; we can toggle auto-apply to avoid finance sign-off if you prefer fast failover.
- Rate-limit policy: we can raise per-account throughput ceilings for the duration of the burst (controlled via a short-lived policy flag). That avoids changing global rate limits but keeps your traffic smooth.

Operational note for Grace: please draft the policy that allows a one-time policy flag to expand throughput ceilings for Novafin during the burst period. We’ll need a rollback SLA.

Elena — we can present a final addendum for signature tomorrow if the terms below look good:
- 12-month term, 3x commit, effective 2027-06-01
- Prepaid burst: $75k pool, 60-day expiry, auto-apply = optional

-Ben
Director, Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Following up with the numbers:

Onboarding baseline: current commit = 60M tokens/month.
Option A (3x): 180M tokens/month commit, committed monthly fee $94,500 (12-month). Effective unit = $0.000525/token.
Option B (burst): keep 60M commit, prepaid burst = 75M tokens usable within 60 days, one-time $46,000. Unit price during burst follows the next band rate but charged from the prepaid pool.

If Novafin opts for Option A and traffic overshoots the commit by >10% for 3 consecutive billing cycles, we recommend an auto-upgrade trigger to a 4x band (subject to approval).

I’ve added the rate-breakdown in the sheet. Let me know if you want us to bake in an automatic trigger clause.

-Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novafin Billing <billing@novafin.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Thanks — the numbers look reasonable. A few requests before we sign:
1) Can we get a 30-day notice window on any auto-upgrade trigger? We want a chance to push back or rearchitect before commitment increases.
2) For the burst pool, set auto-apply = ON for the first 30 days and then require billing approval thereafter.
3) Can Redwood provide a short appendix describing how the throughput ceiling flag interacts with per-route quotas? We want to be sure internal rate-limiting in our app won’t be interfered with.

If you can send a one-page addendum with those two controls and the updated pricing, we’ll aim to sign by EOD Wednesday.

—Elena
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <erossi@novafin.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + anticipated usage changes

Elena — perfect, we can do all three asks. Next steps:
- Grace will drop the short appendix on throughput + route quota interactions by EOD today.
- Ben and I will produce a one-page addendum with: 30-day auto-upgrade notice clause, burst auto-apply default (30 days) then manual approval, and the final pricing table reflecting Option A.
- Legal/Finance will prepare the DocuSign link once you ACK the addendum.

I’ll send the addendum in ~4 hours. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: policy appendix (will be uploaded), addendum draft (coming)
